The collision policy exists because kod-auto-improve runs `claude` too; the watchdog runs neither claude nor a build - it makes a handful of gh API calls and exits in seconds. The rule's mechanism does not apply. Pinned to this exact time pair: changing either time invalidates this acknowledgement.

failover.notes: The watchdog plist is NOT rendered by `apply --local` and carries no SCED_SYNC_SCHED_* guard bound. These times are advisory and are checked by the `failover.window` rule.
